title: Trusted colleagues report firsthand encounters with beings

tellings.quote: sounds, the most trusted people in my circle that I have worked with and do work with um have those speak to having those firsthand experiences with.

plain: Some of the most trusted people a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber has worked with, and still works with, say they have met non-human beings face to face. Barber, who says he flew a UFO out with his helicopter, tells Michels this without naming any of them, saying only that those people "speak to having those firsthand experiences." He offers it as a reason to take such encounters seriously, since it comes from people he trusts.
